title: Print Queue
description: Validate and fix page ordering using dependency rules.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse ordering rules (`X|Y` means page X must come before page Y) and a list of page updates.

## Part 1

For each update, check whether all applicable rules are satisfied by comparing positions. Sum the middle page numbers of all valid updates.

## Part 2

For each invalid update, fix the ordering by repeatedly swapping pages that violate a rule until no violations remain. This is essentially a bubble sort guided by the dependency rules. Sum the middle page numbers of the corrected updates.
